title.en: Tale 6 — The Key in the Light

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.en: Juha lost his key at night.

sentences.ar: قعد يدور عليه تحت الضوء بالشارع.
sentences.en: He was searching for it under the light in the street.
His neighbour came and searched with him.
He asked him: where exactly did the key fall?
Juha said: it fell inside the house.

sentences.ar: قال الجار: وليش عم تدور هون؟
sentences.en: The neighbour said: and why are you searching here?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: لأنه هون في ضوء.
sentences.en: Juha said: because here there is light.
